svg.text: Shopper types or speaks in Thai or English
Web proxies /api/* to the API on Cloud Run
API loads the U-Tag profile and chat history
Gemini plans; search runs keyword + pgvector
Filter and rank; steps and 3 picks stream back
Voice in and out through ElevenLabs
"Buy" or "pay by card" in chat sends a checkout request
Order is created with a Stripe Checkout session
Shopper pays by PromptPay QR or card (test mode)
API polls Stripe; paid order joins U-Tag history
One SSE contract for web and API
